nodes.name: Sklearn LogisticRegressionCV Best/refit Selection Shell Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic LogisticRegressionCV.fit best-index, refit-initialization, non-refit averaging, and final component packaging around the solver boundary.

nodes.name: logistic_cv_loop_path_views
nodes.description: Return the per-loop score and coefficient-path views used by OvR or multinomial CV selection.
nodes.type_signature: (multi_class: str, cls: object, scores_by_class: Mapping[object, object], coefs_paths_by_class: Mapping[object, object], multinomial_scores: object, multinomial_coefs_paths: object) -> tuple[object, object]

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: scores and coefficient paths visible inside the loop body

nodes.name: logistic_cv_best_flat_index
nodes.description: Return the flattened best path index from summed fold scores.

nodes.name: logistic_cv_best_C_l1_selection
nodes.description: Return selected C and l1-ratio values from a flattened best path index.
nodes.type_signature: (best_index: int, Cs: object, l1_ratios: object) -> tuple[object, object]

inputs.name: l1_ratios
inputs.type_desc: l1-ratio grid, possibly containing None for non-elastic-net penalties

nodes.name: logistic_cv_refit_coef_init
nodes.description: Return coefficient initialization for the refit solver boundary from best path coefficients.
nodes.type_signature: (coefs_paths: object, *, multi_class: str, best_index: int) -> NDArray[np.floating]

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: coefficient initialization passed to the solver callback

nodes.name: logistic_cv_nonrefit_best_indices
nodes.description: Return one best path index per fold for the non-refit branch.

nodes.name: logistic_cv_nonrefit_average_w
nodes.description: Return the non-refit averaged coefficient vector or matrix from fold-specific best path entries.
nodes.type_signature: (coefs_paths: object, best_indices: object, *, multi_class: str) -> NDArray[np.floating]

nodes.name: logistic_cv_nonrefit_average_C
nodes.description: Return the non-refit mean selected C value.

nodes.name: logistic_cv_nonrefit_average_l1_ratio
nodes.description: Return the non-refit mean selected l1-ratio for elastic-net penalties, else None.
nodes.type_signature: (best_indices: object, Cs: object, l1_ratios: object, penalty: str) -> object

nodes.name: logistic_cv_multinomial_final_components
nodes.description: Return multinomial final C, l1-ratio, coefficient, and optional intercept components from supplied weights.
nodes.type_signature: (C_values: object, l1_ratio_values: object, w: object, *, n_classes: int, n_features: int, fit_intercept: bool) -> tuple[NDArray[object], NDArray[object], NDArray[np.floating], NDArray[np.floating] | None]

inputs.name: C_values
inputs.type_desc: selected C list before multinomial tiling

inputs.name: l1_ratio_values
inputs.type_desc: selected l1-ratio list before multinomial tiling

inputs.name: fit_intercept
inputs.type_desc: whether trailing intercept weights are present

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: C_, l1_ratio_, coef_, and optional intercept_ components

nodes.name: logistic_cv_ovr_final_row
nodes.description: Return one OvR coefficient row and optional intercept value from supplied weights.
nodes.type_signature: (w: object, *, n_features: int, fit_intercept: bool) -> tuple[NDArray[np.floating], object]

inputs.name: fit_intercept
inputs.type_desc: whether a trailing intercept weight is present

metadata.remediation_case: Case 2 external optimizer boundary best/refit selection state
